summary: Anfield Energy Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 28, 2026, attaching a press release dated August 27, 2026, announcing the first underground blast at its Velvet-Wood uranium and vanadium project in Utah, the first in nearly 40 years, following a blast permit from the U.S. ATF. The filing details rehabilitation progress, including the first 700 feet of the decline, infrastructure installation, and near-completion of a water treatment plant, supporting the company's hub-and-spoke strategy around the Shootaring Canyon Mill. This is an operational milestone, not a special-situation corporate event. No transaction terms, board actions, or advisors are mentioned. What to watch: continued operational progress and regulatory approvals.
